prompt_text: I want to try a tanning salon in Pleasanton. Which specific salons should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Pleasanton CA?
answer_verbatim:
Quick question before I make specific suggestions: do you mean Pleasanton, CA (Bay Area) and do you want UV tanning (beds) or spray/airbrush? Any preferences on price, distance, or level of experience (first time vs regular)?

While you answer, here’s something useful you can use immediately — the exact salons I should look up for you will depend on your answers, but when you call any tanning salon, these are the specific things to ask and why each matters:

What to ask when you call (and why)
- Do you offer spray/airbrush tanning, tanning beds, or both?
  - To make sure they provide the service you want; many people prefer spray-only for safety.
- What types/levels of tanning beds do you have (low/medium/high pressure)?
  - Different beds give different results and UV exposure; high-pressure (bronzing) beds are stronger and not ideal for beginners.
- Do you have first-time client specials or single-session pricing?
  - Good to know cost and whether they have introductory packages.
- Do you offer memberships or packages, and what are cancellation terms?
  - Memberships can save money if you’ll go regularly—ask about lock-in and fees.
- What training/certifications does staff have for spray tans and bed operation?
  - Properly trained staff reduce mistakes and improve safety.
- How do you maintain/clean beds and spray booths? How often are they sanitized?
  - Cleanliness is important for infection control and comfort.
- What is your policy for contraindications (medications, pregnancy, skin conditions)?
  - Some meds/conditions make tanning unsafe; a reputable salon screens for that.
- Do you have UV-protection goggles and do you provide them?
  - Goggles protect your eyes from UV damage.
- What are your hours and typical wait times for appointments/walk-ins?
  - Helpful for planning.
- Do you use DHA-only solutions for spray tans and do you offer custom color/airbrush?
  - To understand product quality and customization.
- Can you send before/after photos or client reviews?
  - Helps judge results and consistency.

Red flags to avoid
- No training/certification or evasive answers about staff qualifications.
- Poor sanitation practices or inability to describe cleaning routines.
- Pressure to buy large pre-paid packages up front without a trial session.
- No goggles for UV beds or inability to describe bed types and exposure times.

If you want, I can now look up and give you 4–6 specific salons in Pleasanton (with addresses and phone numbers) and highlight which to call first based on whether you want spray only vs UV. Which Pleasanton and which tanning method do you prefer?
